candidates.pitch: Pond hockey with marked slow and fast ice patches and springy corner bumpers; outscore the bot team.
You're the pond local who knows every patch, slingshotting past visitors and banking passes off corner bumpers.
You're the trick-shot hustler: goals banked off corner bumpers count double, so every corner becomes a weapon.
You're the thaw survivor: slow slush spreads each period while shrinking fast lanes become the prize both teams fight over.
You're the ice thief: each goal lets the conceding team move one fast patch, bending the pond toward comeback.

concept.why: You own this pond. Within 30 seconds you cut onto fast ice, burst past a chaser, and bank off a corner bumper to a teammate. Candidate 0 offers the same features without that mastery fantasy.
concept.hook: knowing the pond's fast ice, slow ice and corner bumpers wins

references.borrow: Pass across the crease and shoot as it arrives; the goalie cannot get across in time.
Cross a dash panel for an instant burst; off-road slows you, so choosing your line matters.
Six full-boost pads sit in fixed places; players who learn their positions win the race there.
